security_concerns: frontend/src/utils/businessChatSessions.ts:473 persists raw.presentation wholesale. The bundle says debug/query metadata must not be stored or replayed, but backend presentation.debug is explicitly present in the tested final payload, so debug fields can bypass the rawResponse whitelist and be written into session storage.
logic_errors: frontend/src/views/business-chat/BusinessChatPage.vue:1870 calls presentation.caveatItems.length without guarding for caveatItems being undefined. The comment says it supports old caveats-only protocol, but an older persisted/server payload without caveatItems can throw at runtime before falling back.
suggestions: Normalize persisted presentation the same way rawResponse is normalized, or explicitly strip presentation.debug and any non-display/internal fields before saving sessions.
Change caveat fallback to guard optional arrays, for example using Array.isArray(presentation.caveatItems) before reading .length.
summary: Failed closed: the mini bundle indicates one storage/data-minimization issue around presentation.debug persistence and one backward-compatibility runtime error in caveat handling. api_key="test-key" is treated as a test fixture and ignored.
